title.narrative: Advancing production of Orange Fleshed Sweet Potato to Empower Smallholder farmers in Plateau State

description.narrative:
This proposal aims to deepen intervention to improve the livelihoods of rural communities in Plateau State by integrating Orange Fleshed Sweet Potato (OFSP) production with climate change resilience strategies. It will include coping mechanisms through the provision of WASH facilities, Village Savings and Loan Associations (VSLA), and peacebuilding initiatives. By mainstreaming these components, the project aims to enhance food security, economic resilience, and social cohesion among rural households, ultimately contributing to sustainable development and peace in eight communities across the Barkin Ladi and Bokkos local government areas of Plateau State.
Additionally, the Radio live phone-in program and feedback from men during the various training workshops particularly the Market Systems Development Workshop, there has been a strong call for the inclusion of men in the project’s implementation. To ensure the sustainability of this initiative in Plateau State, scaling up the project for another year is essential.
